sloka: स दृष्ट्वा तां सुदुर्मेधा अनङ्गशरपीडितः ।अभिगम्य सुसंविग्नां कन्यां वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ७.८०.५ ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā tāṁ sudurmedhā anaṅgaśarapīḍitaḥ ।abhigamya susaṁvignāṁ kanyāṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 7.80.5 ।।

translations.english: Having seen her, the very foolish king, afflicted by the arrows of Kama, approached the very agitated maiden and spoke words to her.
